hubMetaTitle: K-3 Standards Checklists: Common Core and Texas TEKS by Grade
hubMetaDescription: Standards checklists for Kindergarten to Grade 3: Common Core math and ELA and the Texas TEKS, each code with the lessons and worksheets that teach it.
hubTitle: Standards Checklists for Kindergarten to Grade 3
hubLead: Each checklist lists the standards of one grade and one subject by their official codes. After each code you see what the children do in our lessons, the lessons that teach it, and the worksheets that go with them. Codes we have nothing for are listed too, so a checklist shows what is covered and what is not.
hubPageFacts: {taught} of {objectives} standards with lessons or worksheets
hubMissing: Third grade ELA and science have no checklist yet: our lessons cover too few of their standards for a checklist to be useful.
hubNote: These checklists are aligned to the standards they name. They are not published, reviewed, or approved by the organizations that wrote the standards.
